|translation='''Title:''' Blaster.

'''Card text:'''
Use 1 Force to deploy on any warrior. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny > maneuver or armor.

'''Lore:'''
A Merr-Sonn Model 44 blaster pistol. It uses a power pack and high-pressure blaster gas to fire explosive coherent light.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore prints 머ソン44型 and high-pressure blaster gas (高圧) rather than high-energy.
